name: Goblin
description: A weak goblin creature, perfect for beginners

name: Bank Clerk
description: A helpful bank clerk who manages deposits and withdrawals

nodes.text: Welcome to the bank! How may I help you today?

responses.text: I'd like to access my bank.

nodes.text: Of course! Here are your belongings.
We offer secure storage for your items. You can deposit items to keep them safe, and withdraw them whenever you need.

responses.text: I'd like to access my bank.

nodes.text: Take care, adventurer!

name: Shopkeeper
description: A friendly merchant who buys and sells goods

nodes.text: Can I help you at all?
Take a look!
Come back anytime.

name: Captain Rowan
description: Captain of the town guard. Methodical, haunted, and rarely surprised — but this has him worried.

nodes.text: Halt, traveler! The roads aren't safe. Goblins have been attacking anyone who ventures outside town.

responses.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

nodes.text: You look capable enough. If you could thin their numbers - say, fifteen of the wretches - it would make the roads safer for everyone. I can offer you a sword and a reward for your trouble.
Excellent! Take this sword. Return to me once you've slain fifteen goblins. Good luck, adventurer.
How goes the goblin hunt? Have you slain fifteen of them yet?
Keep at it. The town is counting on you.
They've set up camp east of town, near the old ruins. Be careful out there.
You've done it! Fifteen goblins slain. The roads will be safer thanks to you. Here's your reward - you've earned it.

You handled the goblins well. There's a harder problem now. Three merchant caravans hit this week — same stretch of north road, same hour of night. Bandits don't operate that precisely without someone directing them. Someone with money and a plan.

Fifteen of them. Make it count — and while you're at it, search the camp properly. They're organised, which means there are orders somewhere. Written orders leave trails. Find them and bring them back.

responses.text: I'll find out who's behind it.

nodes.text: Don't just kill them. Look at what they're carrying, what's in the tent at the back. Evidence matters as much as bodies.
Have you cleared the camp? I need whatever they were holding — letters, ledgers, a seal. Anything that points back to who hired them.
Every one you take down is a merchant family that gets home safely. Keep at it.
Rocky passes north-east of town. The leader stays near the back — better equipped than the rest. That's where the orders will be.

A sealed letter. Black wax, no crest — just a hand burned into it. I've seen this mark before. Once. On a body. The man was a trade commissioner who started asking the wrong questions about disappearing caravans. This is the Ashen Hand. They don't steal coin — they destabilise regions. Create fear, cut off trade, then move in when the town is desperate enough to accept any offer. Ask yourself who profits when this place falls. That's the Hand. Go find Torvin. Show him that mark. He'll know what it means for the clans.
The north road is clear, for now. But the Hand doesn't abandon investments — they recalibrate. Torvin needs to know what we found. Go to him.
Stay safe out there, traveler.

name: Forester Wilma
description: A skilled woodcutter who maintains the forest near town

nodes.text: Hello there! The village needs firewood, but I've hurt my back. Could you help?
Chop 6 logs from the trees nearby, then light them on fire to prove you can do it. Here's a hatchet and tinderbox.
Thank you! The trees are just outside town. Use the tinderbox on the logs to light a fire.
How's it going? Chopped and burned those logs yet?
Keep at it! Chop trees for logs, then use the tinderbox on the logs to light fires.
Wonderful! You've proven you can gather and use firewood. Here's your reward.
Thanks again for the help! Feel free to keep chopping trees anytime.
Come back if you change your mind.

name: Fisherman Pete
description: A weathered fisherman who supplies the local market

nodes.text: Ahoy! The tavern needs cooked shrimp. Care to help an old fisherman?

responses.text: I'd like to see your fishing supplies.

nodes.text: Catch 6 shrimp from the fishing spots, then cook them on a fire or range. Here's a net.
Excellent! The fishing spots are by the water. Cook the shrimp on a fire when you're done.
Any luck with the fishing and cooking?
Use the net at fishing spots for shrimp, then cook them on any fire.
Perfect! Those shrimp look delicious. The tavern will be pleased. Here's your reward.
Thanks for the help! Come back anytime you want to fish.
Here's what I've got - fresh fish and all the gear you need!
Come back if you want to help.

name: Torvin
description: Dwarven smith. Gruff, precise, and quietly terrified by what the Ashen Hand's involvement means.

nodes.text: Hail, traveler! I've got orders piling up and not enough hands. Care to learn the trade?

responses.text: I'd like to buy some weapons.

nodes.text: I need a full set of bronze tools - a sword, hatchet, and pickaxe. Mine the ore, smelt the bars, and forge them yourself. Here's a pickaxe and hammer to get started.

responses.text: That sounds like a lot of work.

nodes.text: Good! You'll need 4 copper and 4 tin ore. Smelt them at the furnace, then use the anvil to forge the tools.
How's the smithing coming along?
Copper rocks are orange, tin is grey. Smelt the ore at the furnace, then hammer the bars into shape at the anvil.
Ha! Fine work for a beginner. You've got the makings of a smith. Keep the tools - you've earned them.
Good work on the bronze. Come back when Rowan sends you — I have a feeling he will.

The Ashen Hand. Aye, I know that mark. Been seeing their agents in the market for months — thought they were just traders. They're not. They went to Grundar with a deal: lead the raid, we'll arm your clan through winter. He's not doing this for conquest — his people are starving and the Hand handed him a war and called it salvation. Someone made a monster out of a man who didn't have many choices. Doesn't make the raid less real.

Bronze won't hold against what's coming. Clan warriors fight in iron. You need iron too — but you're going to earn it. Mine the ore yourself. Smelt it yourself. Forge it yourself. A blade you made with your own hands is a blade you trust when everything else is going wrong. Eight iron ore, three bars, one scimitar. I'll be here.
Iron fails the furnace more than bronze — bring more ore than you think you need. Three bars is what you need for the scimitar. I'll check your work at the anvil. Don't rush it.
Have you forged the scimitar? Tested it on the outriders?

responses.text: What level do I need to smelt iron?

nodes.text: Iron rewards patience. Don't rush the furnace — a bad bar makes a brittle blade. And a brittle blade gets you killed against clan steel.
Level fifteen at the furnace, level twenty at the anvil for a scimitar. If you're not there, spend more time on bronze first.

The outriders are down. Good. Grundar will feel that — when scouts stop reporting, a warchief starts preparing for an assault. You've shortened the timeline. The blade you forged held, which means you made it right. Keep it. It has a name now — Torvin's Promise. I don't name things I made poorly. Horvik is waiting. He trained Grundar's father, watched Grundar grow up. He won't be glad to hear what needs doing — but he already knows. Go to him.
Horvik's at the armoury. Don't delay — Grundar won't.
Fine blades, every one of them. Take your pick!
Don't rush the furnace.

name: Ellis
description: A tanner who can turn hides into leather

nodes.text: Greetings, friend. I'm a tanner — I can tan any hides you bring me.
Let me see what you've got.
Come back if you need any leather.

name: Cow
description: A docile cow grazing in the field

name: Dark Wizard
description: A sinister wizard who attacks with Wind Strike magic

name: Dark Ranger
description: A shadowy archer who fires bronze arrows from the darkness

name: Zamorin
description: A mysterious wizard who deals in runes, staves, and magical equipment

nodes.text: Greetings, seeker of the arcane. The runecrafting altars nearby hold great power, but I lack the essence to fuel them. Could you assist me?

responses.text: What do you need help with?
I'd like to browse your wares.

nodes.text: The essence rocks near the altars contain rune essence - the raw material for crafting runes. Mine 25 essence, then use them at the air altar to craft air runes. Here's a pickaxe to get you started.
Excellent! The essence rocks are just south of here, near the runecrafting altars. Mine the essence, then use it at the air altar to craft air runes.
How goes the runecrafting? Have you mined the essence and crafted the air runes?

responses.text: I'd like to browse your wares.

nodes.text: The essence rocks are near the altars to the south. Mine the essence, then use it at the air altar.
Wonderful! You've grasped the fundamentals of runecrafting. The arcane arts are now open to you. Here's your reward.
Ah, my star pupil returns. Feel free to browse my wares or continue crafting runes at the altars.

responses.text: I'd like to browse your wares.

nodes.text: Runes, staves, robes... everything a mage could desire.
May the arcane guide your path.

name: Lowe
description: A skilled bowyer and fletcher who sells ranged weapons and supplies

nodes.text: Looking for ranged gear? I sell the finest bows and arrows, but I could also teach you to make your own. Interested?
A good ranger makes their own ammunition. Use a knife on logs to cut arrow shafts, add feathers to make headless arrows, then string a shortbow. Here's everything you need.
Good! Use the knife on the logs for arrow shafts, combine shafts with feathers for headless arrows, then use the knife on logs again and add a bowstring to make a shortbow.
How's the fletching coming along?

responses.text: I'd like to buy some supplies.

nodes.text: Knife on logs for shafts, feathers on shafts for headless arrows. For the bow, cut a shortbow from logs and add a bowstring.
Well done! You've got a natural talent for fletching. Keep it up and you'll be crafting magic shortbows in no time. Here's your reward.
My best student! Need any supplies for your fletching?
Take your pick - finest bows and arrows around!
Come back if you need any ranged supplies.

name: Horvik
description: Old armorer. Has seen more wars than he'll speak of. Knows Grundar personally, and that makes this harder.

nodes.text: Need armour? Come back later — I'm in the middle of something. Unless Torvin sent you.

Grundar. I trained his father. Watched the boy grow up. He was never cruel — just stubborn, proud of his clan. The Ashen Hand came to him with a choice: lead the raid, we arm your people through winter, or watch your clan starve while your rivals grow stronger. He chose the raid. I won't pretend I wouldn't have done the same with three thousand starving mouths behind me. But the raid can't happen. And Grundar won't pull back — the four clans won't follow an order to stand down. The Hand made sure of that. There's only one way to stop this now.

His camp is north, past the rocky outcrops. Fifteen warriors between you and him — clan soldiers, not mercenaries. They'll die for him without hesitation. Cut through them and reach Grundar. Make it quick. He deserves that much.

responses.text: I have the iron blade. I'll end it.
I need more time to prepare.

nodes.text: Fifteen warriors, then Grundar. Without him the four clans fall back to fighting each other — that's how barbarian politics work. The raid dies with him. Just... make it count.
Is it done? Every hour is an hour closer to that raid reaching our gates.

responses.text: Remind me where the camp is.

nodes.text: The warriors are the wall. Grundar is what's behind it. Get through.
North of the barbarian village, past the rocky outcrops. Grundar camps at the centre — bigger than the rest, better armed. You'll know him when you see him.

It's done. Scouts confirm the clans are fragmenting — without Grundar to hold them, they're already arguing succession. The raid won't come. What did he say? Before the end. A man like Grundar doesn't die without saying something. ...The Ashen Hand. He named them. Of course he did — he'd have wanted that out. They'd have buried his involvement, blamed a rogue warchief, moved on to the next region. Now we know what they are and that they're still here. That makes us a threat to them. Keep that in mind.

Take Grundar's axe. He carried it for his clan — it shouldn't rust in the dirt. You stopped the raid he was forced to lead. That's something. The Ashen Hand doesn't lose investments quietly. We've cost them a warchief and a region. They'll know who's responsible. Watch your back, adventurer. And tell no one who really gave Grundar his orders — not yet. We need time to understand how deep this goes.
Helms, platebodies, shields - take a look!
Stay safe out there.

name: Barbarian Warchief
description: Grundar — warchief of four united clans. Not a monster by nature. Made into one by necessity and by the Ashen Hand's offer.

name: Dommik
description: A crafting supplier who sells leather, gems, moulds, and other crafting materials

nodes.text: Welcome! I stock everything you need for crafting. Say, you look like you could learn a thing or two about leatherwork. Interested?
Use a needle and thread on leather to craft gloves and boots. Make 5 of each and I'll know you've got the basics down. Here's a needle, some thread, and leather to get started.
Great! Use the needle on the leather with thread in your inventory. Craft 5 leather gloves and 5 leather boots, then come back to me.
How's the crafting going? Finished those gloves and boots?
Use the needle on leather to craft. You need 5 leather gloves and 5 leather boots. If you run out of materials, you can buy more from me.
Excellent work! Those stitches are nice and tight. You're a natural crafter. Here's your reward.
Good to see you again! Need any more crafting supplies?
Here's what I've got - all the finest crafting supplies!
Come back when you need crafting materials.

name: Guard
description: A town guard armed with an iron longsword, tasked with keeping the peace

name: Bandit
description: A cunning outlaw who preys on unwary travelers

name: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior from the desert lands
